measurement_model: B = P O, P in {0,1}^(N x 4096) i.i.d. Bernoulli(0.5), noise-free, float64
pseudoinverse: thin SVD P = U S V^T; O = V S^-1 U^T B (min-norm if N<4096, least squares if N>=4096); singular values < 1e-12 s_max dropped; result clipped to [0,1] for metrics

tv.objective: 0.5||W(P O - B)||^2 + lambda * TV_iso(O), O in [0,1]; W whitens residuals so the data term is 0.5||V^T(O - O_pinv)||^2 (N<4096) or 0.5||O - O_ls||^2 (N>=4096)
tv.solver: FISTA (step 1 = 1/L), 300 iterations; prox = FGP (Beck-Teboulle) with box [0,1], 10 inner iterations, warm-started dual
tv.lambda_selection: lowest mean MSE on 40 training images (seed 2026), frozen per N
